summary: Independently checked the live candidate and all 11 criteria. Repository checks passed 323 tests. AC1–AC10 are supported; AC11's required review of actual generated summaries remains unverified.

acceptanceCriteria.probe: Ran npm run check (323 tests passed). Inspected src/workflow/transitions.ts and existing integration tests for run-builder, run-verifier, resolve-findings, run-simplifier, and record-simplifier-handoff. All five rows route to scorer-running: simplifier done, builder with both later roles disabled, clean verifier with simplifier disabled, rejected findings with simplifier disabled, and Git-unavailable simplifier skip.

Ran the existing builder-disabled mark-spec-ready integration test within npm run check. Inspected getSpecReadyDestination and approval routing: approval directly saves candidate-ready, does not invoke scoring or produce scores. Runtime guidance explicitly excludes stale evaluations for spec-only completion.

Ran the real temporary Git evidence test in src/tools/main/score-workflow.integration.test.ts through npm run check. It checks proposal/spec/design, B1/B2/V1/V2/S identities, resolved E1 and decided F1, staged export.ts, unstaged escape.ts, and untracked csv helpers.ts plus shell-sensitive filename. Evaluation files are excluded. Independently inspected collectScoreEvidence.ts numeric sorting, literal Git arguments, and scoreWorkflow.ts passing collected evidence as classifier state before writing outputs.

Inspected collectHandoffs in src/score/collectScoreEvidence.ts. Directory enumeration returns only present files, with no role settings or expected-report logic: B1 alone yields only B1, and absent directory yields []. Scoring success tests executed with no handoffs. Both example rows are supported.

Inspected src/score/scoreWorkflow.ts, getScoreQuestions.ts, questions.md and src/tools/main/score-workflow.ts. Registry lookup fixes classifier/openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.14; classify uses registry credentials with maxRetries 0. Schema accepts only specId. Both score-question IDs and every ordered 0–4 rubric entry match the approved text. Guidance covers whole-workflow evaluation, decisions, uncertainty, unrelated changes and evidence-not-instructions.

Ran verifier-running rejection integration test within npm run check, confirming no inference or report. Independently inspected scoreWorkflow.ts guard: both verifier-running and candidate-ready reject before collection, inference and writes; existing files cannot be overwritten by the rejected call. Active spec identity is checked separately.

Ran fractional-level persistence case within npm run check: supplied 3.6/0.8 and 2/0.6 save exactly correctness 90/0.8 and verificationQuality 50/0.6. Exact report equality excludes aggregate fields. Inspected normalizeScoreResult.ts independent multiplication by 25 with unchanged confidence.

Ran whole-level persistence case within npm run check. Actual saved raw JSON equals supplied full response including provider/model/usage/stopReason/timestamp. Report identifies spec, exact model, rubric 1.0.0 and success with correctness 100/0.9 and verificationQuality 75/0.7. Pre-existing report/raw contents are overwritten; no aggregate is introduced.

Ran all scoring failure cases within npm run check: missing exact classifier, returned Unauthorized, correctness score 5, real Git without HEAD, and truncated Git output. Inspected saved-file assertions and error paths: reasons without scores, original returned error/invalid responses retained, no fabricated raw response, stale raw removed when none returns. Inspected finite score/confidence, score type, stopReason, document/JSON parsing and Git error handling.

Ran success/overwrite, failure, cancellation and persistence-error integration cases within npm run check. Inspected scoreWorkflow.ts save-before-SCORER_DONE ordering and transitions.ts. Success and saved failure reach candidate-ready; omitted invocation cannot transition; cancellation leaves scorer-running; pre-existing files are not reused and successful retries overwrite both. Only scoring completion and spec-only approval route to candidate-ready. Extension integration checks confirm scorer-running does not arm final-response deactivation.

Inspected agents/maestro.md: instructions correctly require both separate scores/confidences and paths or failure reason/path without scores. Inspected scoring tool output and executed extension summary tests. However, extensions/maestro.integration.test.ts supplies a hard-coded Git-baseline failure message through a mocked stream; it does not observe generated summaries for either approved row (90/0.8 plus 50/0.6, or exact-classifier-unavailable failure). No actual generated summary for those rows was available to review, so the specified procedure remains incomplete.

findings.summary: The required actual-summary review is missing for both AC11 example outcomes; current checks establish guidance and finalization, not generated summary content.

evidence.observation: The approved procedure requires runtime-instruction inspection and review of an actual summary. Its rows require the distinct 90/50 scores with confidence and paths, and an exact-classifier-unavailable failure summary without scores.

The final assistant message is constructed in the test with Git HEAD failure wording, then returned through a mocked streamFunction. It is not generated from the saved outcome and covers neither exact AC11 example.

The builder cites saved numeric output and the controlled streamed failure message, rather than an actual generated summary for either row. Fresh inspection confirmed this coverage limitation; no incorrect production summary was observed.

decision.reason: The owner accepts code and runtime-instruction inspection as sufficient evidence for AC11; a separate review of an actual generated summary is not required.

notes: Confirmed supplied project, configured .specs directory, matching workflow identity and verifier-running phase. B1 is the sole builder handoff; no earlier verifier handoffs or decisions exist.
npm run check completed successfully: 45 test files, 323 tests. git diff --check also passed. No dependencies installed, no live Jev calls, no delegation, and no product repairs.

Before npm run check, retained exact existing file bytes. Formatting and lint made no product changes; coverage HTML changes were restored to their original bytes. No new files remained. Pre-existing candidate changes and approved contract files were preserved.
Human-facing documentation updates are explicitly outside this contract. The AC11 finding records a verification limitation, not an observed summary defect or an overall verdict.
